answer_1.quote: Evaluation Task t: NLG encompasses a diverse range of tasks , such as Machine Translation (MT) , Text Summarization (TS) , Dialogue Generation (DG) , Story Generation (SG) , Image Caption (IC) , Data-to-Text generation (D2T)  and General Generation (GE) , each with its unique evaluation requirements.
answer_1.outputs: hypothesis texts (generated outputs) evaluated for quality

answer_2.quote: Traditional metrics such as BLEU  and ROUGE  focus on exacting n-gram matches, which penalizes semantically correct but lexically different hypotheses. ... In contrast, LLMs have a strong capability for language understanding and generation, which supports evaluating quality without needing references.

answer_3.quote: Leveraging the capabilities of LLMs, prompt-based evaluation not only provides a comprehensive understanding of NLG system performance but also offers a nuanced approach to extracting valuable insights. ... The key strategy involves prompting LLMs to evaluate texts from various aspects, with or without references or sources.
